[01 // MISSION]

THE BIRTH OF THE NEXT ERA

OOTY HACKS brings builders together in the heights of Ooty. The hackathon is about what happens when curious people get in a room, look beyond the ordinary, and construct autonomous systems, ecological tools, and self-evolving code.

🤖

Agentic Autonomy

Build multi-agent frameworks capable of complex reasoning, autonomous decision loops, and tool orchestration.

🌱

Ecological & Local Tech

Turn local environmental, agricultural, and community challenges into resilient, deployable systems.

🛡️

Zero-Knowledge & Privacy

Architect verifiable models powered by cryptographic proofs, privacy-preserving AI, and confidential enclaves.

⚡

Quantum & Scaled Compute

Optimize algorithmic throughput with accelerated pipelines, Edge AI, and distributed compute clusters.

    [07 // SYSTEM INQUIRIES]

    FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

    Everything you need to know about OOTY HACKS before you pack your bags for Ooty.

    Who is eligible to participate in OOTY HACKS?+

    People who want to build: developers, designers, students, and curious problem-solvers. Whether you are building solo or in a team of up to 4 people, all backgrounds are welcome.

    Do I need an existing team?+

    You can join solo or with a team. We host a dedicated team-formation session right after kickoff so solo builders can match skills and brainstorm together.

    Where and when is it happening?+

    OOTY HACKS takes place on December 19 & 20, 2026 in Ooty, Tamil Nadu. Official registration checkpoints and opening ceremonies start at 10:00 AM IST on December 19th.

    Is there a registration fee?+

    Participation is free for accepted applicants. The preview lets you prepare and save your draft on this device without cost.

    What are the IP rights for submitted projects?+

    You retain 100% ownership of all IP and software you create during the hackathon.

    What should I prepare before arriving?+

    A laptop, your preferred development environment, and an open mind. You can use the build-brief generator to formulate a plan with your team beforehand.
